entries.example: 我每個月都要繳保險費。
entries.exampleEnglish: I have to pay insurance premiums every month.
entries.question: 你在台灣有買保險嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you bought insurance in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 有，公司幫我買了保險。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my company bought insurance for me.

entries.example: 買東西前，我會先看網路評論。
entries.exampleEnglish: Before I buy something, I check the online reviews first.
entries.question: 你去餐廳前會看評論嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you read reviews before going to a restaurant?
entries.answer: 會，我都先看評論再決定。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always read the reviews before deciding.

entries.example: 颱風來之前，家裡先儲備了水和泡麵。
entries.exampleEnglish: Before the typhoon came, we stocked up on water and instant noodles at home.
entries.question: 颱風來之前，你會儲備什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you stock up on before a typhoon?
entries.answer: 我會儲備水、泡麵和電池。
entries.answerEnglish: I stock up on water, instant noodles and batteries.

entries.exampleEnglish: It's a bit cold today.
entries.question: 你今天累嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you tired today?
entries.answer: 有點累，昨天睡得很晚。
entries.answerEnglish: A little. I went to bed late last night.

entries.exampleEnglish: My sock has a hole in it.
entries.question: 你的衣服破洞了會怎麼辦？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do when your clothes get a hole?
entries.answer: 衣服破洞我就買新的。
entries.answerEnglish: If my clothes get a hole, I just buy new ones.

entries.exampleEnglish: We took a boat to Xiaoliuqiu.
entries.question: 你在台灣坐過船嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you been on a boat in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 坐過，我在日月潭坐過船。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I took a boat on Sun Moon Lake.

entries.exampleEnglish: My older sister is a scientist.
entries.question: 你小時候想當科學家嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did you want to be a scientist when you were little?
entries.answer: 想啊，我小時候想當科學家。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I wanted to be a scientist as a kid.

entries.exampleEnglish: I haven't been sleeping well lately.
entries.question: 你的睡眠時間夠嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you get enough sleep?
entries.answer: 不太夠，我每天睡眠不到六小時。
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. I sleep less than six hours a night.

entries.example: 她買了一雙金色的鞋子。
entries.exampleEnglish: She bought a pair of gold shoes.
entries.question: 你喜歡金色的東西嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like gold-colored things?
entries.answer: 不太喜歡，金色太亮了。
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. Gold is too flashy.

entries.example: 下雨後，鞋子上都是泥土。
entries.exampleEnglish: After the rain, my shoes were covered in mud.
entries.question: 你小時候常玩泥土嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did you often play in the dirt as a child?
entries.answer: 常玩，我很喜歡玩泥土。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I loved playing in the dirt.

entries.exampleEnglish: I bought a new camera.
entries.question: 你旅行會帶相機嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you take a camera when you travel?
entries.answer: 不帶相機，我用手機拍。
entries.answerEnglish: I don't take a camera; I use my phone.

entries.example: 我喜歡自己住，比較自由。
entries.exampleEnglish: I like living alone; I have more freedom.
entries.question: 你覺得在台灣生活自由嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you feel free living in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 很自由，我想做什麼都可以。
entries.answerEnglish: Very free. I can do whatever I want.

entries.example: 我在收集便利商店的點數。
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm collecting convenience store points.
entries.question: 你有收集什麼東西嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you collect anything?
entries.answer: 我喜歡收集明信片。
entries.answerEnglish: I like collecting postcards.

entries.example: 水滾了，鍋子冒出很多白煙。
entries.exampleEnglish: The water's boiling, and lots of steam is coming out of the pot.
entries.question: 你最近有冒出什麼新想法嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have any new ideas popped into your head lately?
entries.answer: 有，我突然冒出想學衝浪的想法。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I suddenly had the idea to learn surfing.

entries.exampleEnglish: My older brother is getting married next year.
entries.question: 你結婚了嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you married?
entries.answer: 還沒，我還沒結婚。
entries.answerEnglish: Not yet, I'm not married yet.

entries.example: 包裹裡的杯子在運送時損壞了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The cup in the package was damaged in transit.
entries.question: 你網購的東西有損壞過嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Has anything you bought online ever arrived damaged?
entries.answer: 有一次，杯子送來時就損壞了。
entries.answerEnglish: Once, a cup was already damaged when it arrived.

entries.example: 這些點數可以兌換一杯咖啡。
entries.exampleEnglish: These points can be redeemed for a cup of coffee.
entries.question: 你都在哪裡兌換外幣？
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you usually exchange foreign currency?
entries.answer: 我都在機場的銀行兌換。
entries.answerEnglish: I usually exchange it at the bank at the airport.

entries.exampleEnglish: There's nobody in the office.
entries.question: 你家現在有人嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is anyone at your home now?
entries.answer: 沒有人，大家都出去了。
entries.answerEnglish: Nobody. Everyone's gone out.

entries.example: 他因為酒駕被關進監獄。
entries.exampleEnglish: He was sent to prison for drunk driving.
entries.question: 你覺得酒駕應該進監獄嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think drunk drivers should go to prison?
entries.answer: 應該，酒駕太危險了，要關進監獄。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. Drunk driving is too dangerous; they should go to prison.

entries.exampleEnglish: I go back to the US once every year.
entries.question: 你每年都會回國嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you go back to your home country every year?
entries.answer: 對，我每年聖誕節都回國。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I go home every Christmas.

entries.exampleEnglish: Please sign at the bottom of the form.
entries.question: 你填表格時會先看下方的說明嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When you fill in a form, do you read the notes at the bottom first?
entries.answer: 會，我會先看下方的說明。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I read the notes at the bottom first.

entries.exampleEnglish: He's a very accurate shooter.
entries.question: 你打籃球時投籃準嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you accurate when you shoot in basketball?
entries.answer: 不太準，我投籃常常沒進。
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. My shots often miss.

entries.example: 她很喜歡看英國皇家的新聞。
entries.exampleEnglish: She loves reading news about the British royal family.
entries.question: 你對皇家的新聞有興趣嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you interested in royal news?
entries.answer: 沒什麼興趣，我不看皇家新聞。
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. I don't follow royal news.

entries.example: 抽菸會增加得癌症的風險。
entries.exampleEnglish: Smoking increases your risk of getting cancer.
entries.question: 你覺得怎麼做可以預防癌症？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think helps prevent cancer?
entries.answer: 不抽菸、多運動，可以預防癌症。
entries.answerEnglish: Not smoking and exercising more can help prevent cancer.

entries.exampleEnglish: This interview is crucial for me.
entries.question: 你覺得學中文最關鍵的是什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think is most crucial in learning Chinese?
entries.answer: 我覺得最關鍵的是每天練習。
entries.answerEnglish: I think the key is practicing every day.

entries.example: 這間飯店的早餐要額外付錢。
entries.exampleEnglish: Breakfast at this hotel costs extra.
entries.question: 你出國旅行會額外買保險嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you buy extra insurance when you travel abroad?
entries.answer: 會，我會額外買旅遊保險。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I buy extra travel insurance.

entries.example: 政府呼籲大家颱風天不要出門。
entries.exampleEnglish: The government is urging everyone to stay home during the typhoon.
entries.question: 你覺得政府應該呼籲大家做什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think the government should call on people to do?
entries.answer: 應該呼籲大家多搭捷運，少開車。
entries.answerEnglish: It should urge people to take the MRT more and drive less.

entries.example: 下班時間，路上的車輛特別多。
entries.exampleEnglish: At rush hour there are especially many vehicles on the road.
entries.question: 你家附近的車輛多不多？
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a lot of traffic near your home?
entries.answer: 很多，晚上的車輛也很吵。
entries.answerEnglish: Lots. The traffic is noisy even at night.

entries.example: 我的華語考試分數不錯。
entries.exampleEnglish: I got a pretty good score on my Chinese test.
entries.question: 你上次中文考試的分數怎麼樣？
entries.questionEnglish: How did you score on your last Chinese test?
entries.answer: 還不錯，分數比上次高。
entries.answerEnglish: Not bad. My score was higher than last time.

entries.exampleEnglish: The weather in southern Taiwan is hot.
entries.question: 你去過台灣南部嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you been to southern Taiwan?
entries.answer: 去過，我很喜歡南部的小吃。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I love the food in the south.

entries.example: 天氣好的時候，可以看到遠方的山峰。
entries.exampleEnglish: When the weather's good, you can see the peaks in the distance.
entries.question: 你喜歡站在山峰上看風景嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like looking at the view from a mountain peak?
entries.answer: 喜歡，站在山峰上看風景很美。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the view from a peak is beautiful.

entries.example: 看到這張照片，我想起了媽媽。
entries.exampleEnglish: Seeing this photo, I thought of my mom.
entries.question: 什麼食物會讓你想起家鄉？
entries.questionEnglish: What food reminds you of home?
entries.answer: 吃起司會讓我想起家鄉。
entries.answerEnglish: Eating cheese reminds me of home.

entries.example: 太陽落下以後，天氣就涼了。
entries.exampleEnglish: Once the sun goes down, it gets cool.
entries.question: 你看過太陽從海上落下嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever watched the sun go down over the sea?
entries.answer: 看過，在淡水看太陽落下很美。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, watching the sun go down in Tamsui is beautiful.

entries.example: 很多公司正面臨經濟危機。
entries.exampleEnglish: Many companies are facing an economic crisis.
entries.question: 你的工作遇過什麼危機嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you faced any crisis at work?
entries.answer: 有，去年公司發生了財務危機。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, last year my company had a financial crisis.

entries.example: 露營時，我們撿木柴來生火。
entries.exampleEnglish: When camping, we collected firewood to make a fire.
entries.question: 你露營時自己找過木柴嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever gathered your own firewood when camping?
entries.answer: 找過，我們撿了很多木柴來烤肉。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we collected lots of firewood for a barbecue.

entries.exampleEnglish: I can't understand Taiwanese at all.
entries.question: 你聽得懂台語嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you understand Taiwanese?
entries.answer: 完全聽不懂，太難了。
entries.answerEnglish: Not at all. It's too hard.

entries.exampleEnglish: Splitting it this way is fair.
entries.question: 你覺得你的薪水公平嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think your salary is fair?
entries.answer: 我覺得還算公平。
entries.answerEnglish: I think it's reasonably fair.

entries.example: 這隻雄性孔雀的羽毛很漂亮。
entries.exampleEnglish: This male peacock has beautiful feathers.
entries.question: 你養的寵物是雄性還是雌性？
entries.questionEnglish: Is your pet male or female?
entries.answer: 是雄性的，牠是一隻公貓。
entries.answerEnglish: It's male; he's a tomcat.

entries.exampleEnglish: The high-speed rail is very fast.
entries.question: 你打中文字的速度快嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you fast at typing Chinese?
entries.answer: 不快，我打字的速度很慢。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I type slowly.

entries.exampleEnglish: Hurry up, or we'll be late.
entries.question: 你早上為什麼要早點出門？
entries.questionEnglish: Why do you leave home early in the morning?
entries.answer: 要早點出門，否則捷運很擠。
entries.answerEnglish: I have to leave early, otherwise the MRT is packed.

entries.example: 我每週固定去健身房兩次。
entries.exampleEnglish: I go to the gym twice a week, regularly.
entries.question: 你每天有固定的運動時間嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a fixed time for exercise each day?
entries.answer: 有，我每天晚上固定去跑步。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I go running every evening.

entries.exampleEnglish: He walks fast.
entries.question: 你吃飯吃得快嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you eat fast?
entries.answer: 很快，我十分鐘就吃完了。
entries.answerEnglish: Very fast. I finish in ten minutes.

entries.exampleEnglish: This new coworker has a lot of potential.
entries.question: 你覺得自己在哪方面有潛力？
entries.questionEnglish: In what area do you think you have potential?
entries.answer: 我覺得我在語言方面有潛力。
entries.answerEnglish: I think I have potential with languages.

entries.example: 這種植物不常澆水也能存活。
entries.exampleEnglish: This plant can survive without much watering.
entries.question: 你種的植物都能存活嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do the plants you grow survive?
entries.answer: 不太能，我種的花很少存活。
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. Few of my flowers survive.

entries.exampleEnglish: I want to go to Hualien this holiday.
entries.question: 你下一個假期想去哪裡？
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you want to go on your next holiday?
entries.answer: 我下一個假期想去日本。
entries.answerEnglish: On my next holiday I want to go to Japan.

entries.exampleEnglish: He denied eating my cake.
entries.question: 你做錯事時會否認嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you deny it when you've done something wrong?
entries.answer: 不會，我不會否認，我會道歉。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I don't deny it. I apologize.

entries.example: 不要忽視身體的小問題。
entries.exampleEnglish: Don't ignore small health problems.
entries.question: 你工作忙的時候會忽視健康嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you neglect your health when you're busy at work?
entries.answer: 會，忙的時候我常忽視健康。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, when I'm busy I often neglect my health.

entries.example: 台北市民可以免費參加這個活動。
entries.exampleEnglish: Taipei residents can join this event for free.
entries.question: 你覺得台北市民友善嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think the people of Taipei are friendly?
entries.answer: 很友善，台北市民常幫我指路。
entries.answerEnglish: Very. Taipei people often give me directions.

entries.exampleEnglish: Get in touch when you get to Taipei.
entries.question: 你常跟家人聯絡嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you keep in touch with your family often?
entries.answer: 常常，我每天都跟媽媽聯絡。
entries.answerEnglish: Often. I talk to my mom every day.

entries.exampleEnglish: There's a small restaurant in the alley.
entries.question: 你家附近有好吃的餐館嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are there any good restaurants near your home?
entries.answer: 有，有一家越南餐館很好吃。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a really good Vietnamese restaurant.

entries.exampleEnglish: This outfit really suits you.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼工作適合你？
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of job do you think suits you?
entries.answer: 我覺得教英文很適合我。
entries.answerEnglish: I think teaching English suits me.

entries.example: 他把箱子抬起來放上車。
entries.exampleEnglish: He lifted the box and put it in the car.
entries.question: 你搬家時抬起過很重的東西嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you lifted anything heavy when moving house?
entries.answer: 有，我跟朋友一起抬起了沙發。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, a friend and I lifted the sofa together.

entries.example: 他聽到這個消息，反應很大。
entries.exampleEnglish: He reacted strongly when he heard the news.
entries.question: 你第一次吃臭豆腐的反應是什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What was your reaction the first time you ate stinky tofu?
entries.answer: 我的反應是：好臭，但是很好吃！
entries.answerEnglish: My reaction was: it stinks, but it's delicious!

entries.example: 很多媒體都報導了這件事。
entries.exampleEnglish: A lot of media outlets reported on this.
entries.question: 你平常從什麼媒體看新聞？
entries.questionEnglish: What media do you usually get your news from?
entries.answer: 我常用社群媒體看新聞。
entries.answerEnglish: I usually get my news from social media.

entries.exampleEnglish: I take the train to Taichung.
entries.question: 你在台灣坐過火車嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you taken a train in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 坐過，我坐火車去花蓮。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I took the train to Hualien.

entries.exampleEnglish: I bought a new pair of shoes.
entries.question: 你有幾雙鞋子？
entries.questionEnglish: How many pairs of shoes do you have?
entries.answer: 我有五雙鞋子。
entries.answerEnglish: I have five pairs of shoes.

entries.exampleEnglish: Sleep lets your brain rest.
entries.question: 你覺得學中文對大腦好嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think learning Chinese is good for your brain?
entries.answer: 很好，學中文可以訓練大腦。
entries.answerEnglish: Very. Learning Chinese trains your brain.

entries.example: 我朋友開了一間設計工作室。
entries.exampleEnglish: My friend opened a design studio.
entries.question: 你想要有自己的工作室嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to have your own studio?
entries.answer: 想，我想要一間攝影工作室。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd like a photography studio.

entries.example: 早上喝一杯溫熱的水對身體好。
entries.exampleEnglish: A glass of warm water in the morning is good for you.
entries.question: 你早上喜歡喝溫熱的還是冰的？
entries.questionEnglish: In the morning, do you like warm or iced drinks?
entries.answer: 我喜歡喝溫熱的豆漿。
entries.answerEnglish: I like warm soy milk.

entries.exampleEnglish: I feed the cat every morning.
entries.question: 你家的寵物都是誰在餵？
entries.questionEnglish: Who feeds your pet?
entries.answer: 都是我在餵，一天餵兩次。
entries.answerEnglish: I do. I feed it twice a day.

entries.exampleEnglish: Your package will be delivered tomorrow.
entries.question: 你網購的東西通常幾天送達？
entries.questionEnglish: How many days do your online orders usually take to arrive?
entries.answer: 通常兩三天就送達了。
entries.answerEnglish: They usually arrive in two or three days.

entries.example: 珍珠奶茶被視為台灣的國民飲料。
entries.exampleEnglish: Bubble tea is regarded as Taiwan's national drink.
entries.question: 你把台灣視為第二個家嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you consider Taiwan your second home?
entries.answer: 是的，我把台灣視為我的第二個家。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I consider Taiwan my second home.

entries.exampleEnglish: I'll carry your bag for you.
entries.question: 你一隻手可以拿幾杯飲料？
entries.questionEnglish: How many drinks can you hold in one hand?
entries.answer: 我一隻手可以拿兩杯。
entries.answerEnglish: I can hold two in one hand.

entries.exampleEnglish: My fitness coach is very strict.
entries.question: 你運動時有請教練嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a coach when you exercise?
entries.answer: 有，我請了一位游泳教練。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have a swimming coach.

entries.example: 政府在推廣騎單車通勤。
entries.exampleEnglish: The government is promoting cycling to work.
entries.question: 你想向朋友推廣台灣的什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What about Taiwan would you like to promote to your friends?
entries.answer: 我想推廣台灣的夜市小吃。
entries.answerEnglish: I'd like to promote Taiwan's night market food.

entries.example: 我的班機晚上八點起飛。
entries.exampleEnglish: My flight takes off at 8 p.m.
entries.question: 你回國都搭直飛的班機嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you always take a direct flight home?
entries.answer: 不一定，直飛的班機比較貴。
entries.answerEnglish: Not always. Direct flights are more expensive.

entries.exampleEnglish: A police officer is directing traffic at the intersection.
entries.question: 你喜歡指揮別人做事嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like telling other people what to do?
entries.answer: 不喜歡，我不喜歡指揮別人。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I don't like bossing people around.

entries.exampleEnglish: I want to go buy clothes.
entries.question: 你常在哪裡買衣服？
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you usually buy clothes?
entries.answer: 我常在網路上買衣服。
entries.answerEnglish: I usually buy clothes online.

entries.exampleEnglish: She insists on walking to work every day.
entries.question: 你有堅持做什麼運動嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is there any exercise you stick with?
entries.answer: 有，我堅持每天早上跑步。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I keep up running every morning.

entries.exampleEnglish: He gave me a bottle of wine.
entries.question: 你喜歡喝葡萄酒嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like wine?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常喝法國的葡萄酒。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often drink French wine.

entries.example: 我委託房仲幫我找房子。
entries.exampleEnglish: I hired a real estate agent to find me a place.
entries.question: 你找房子時會委託房仲嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When you look for a place, do you use an agent?
entries.answer: 會，我上次就是委託房仲找到的。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, last time I found my place through an agent.

entries.example: 我們從收容所收養了一隻狗。
entries.exampleEnglish: We adopted a dog from a shelter.
entries.question: 你想收養流浪貓嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to adopt a stray cat?
entries.answer: 想，我想收養一隻流浪貓。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd like to adopt a stray cat.

entries.exampleEnglish: This flower is very pretty.
entries.question: 你喜歡什麼顏色的花？
entries.questionEnglish: What color flowers do you like?
entries.answer: 我喜歡白色的花。
entries.answerEnglish: I like white flowers.

entries.example: 早上喝咖啡讓我很有活力。
entries.exampleEnglish: Coffee in the morning gives me energy.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼時候最有活力？
entries.questionEnglish: When do you feel most energetic?
entries.answer: 我早上最有活力。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm most energetic in the morning.

entries.exampleEnglish: This book is very useful.
entries.question: 你覺得哪個中文詞最有用？
entries.questionEnglish: Which Chinese word do you think is the most useful?
entries.answer: 我覺得「謝謝」最有用。
entries.answerEnglish: I think 'thank you' is the most useful.

entries.example: 這家吃到飽有時間限制。
entries.exampleEnglish: This all-you-can-eat place has a time limit.
entries.question: 你會限制自己用手機的時間嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you limit how much time you spend on your phone?
entries.answer: 會，我限制自己一天用三小時。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I limit myself to three hours a day.

entries.example: 這座城堡以前住著一位統治者。
entries.exampleEnglish: A ruler used to live in this castle.
entries.question: 你最欣賞歷史上哪一位統治者？
entries.questionEnglish: Which ruler in history do you admire most?
entries.answer: 我最欣賞的統治者是伊莉莎白一世。
entries.answerEnglish: The ruler I admire most is Elizabeth I.

entries.exampleEnglish: I have a bad headache.
entries.question: 你用電腦太久，哪裡會痛？
entries.questionEnglish: When you use the computer too long, what starts to hurt?
entries.answer: 我的眼睛和脖子會痛。
entries.answerEnglish: My eyes and neck start to hurt.

entries.exampleEnglish: This shop's prices are very fair.
entries.question: 你覺得夜市的價錢公道嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think night market prices are fair?
entries.answer: 大部分很公道，不會太貴。
entries.answerEnglish: Mostly fair. They're not too expensive.

entries.exampleEnglish: On average I walk ten thousand steps a day.
entries.question: 你平均一天睡幾個小時？
entries.questionEnglish: On average, how many hours do you sleep a day?
entries.answer: 我平均一天睡七個小時。
entries.answerEnglish: On average I sleep seven hours a day.

entries.exampleEnglish: Your Chinese has improved a lot!
entries.question: 你覺得你的中文有進步嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think your Chinese has improved?
entries.answer: 有，我的聽力進步了很多。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my listening has improved a lot.

entries.example: 他承認自己犯下了大錯。
entries.exampleEnglish: He admitted he had made a big mistake.
entries.question: 你說中文時犯過什麼好笑的錯誤？
entries.questionEnglish: What funny mistakes have you made speaking Chinese?
entries.answer: 我曾經犯下把「水餃」說成「睡覺」的錯誤。
entries.answerEnglish: I once made the mistake of saying 'sleep' when I meant 'dumplings'.

entries.example: 工作和生活要保持平衡。
entries.exampleEnglish: You need to keep a balance between work and life.
entries.question: 你的工作和生活平衡嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is your work-life balance good?
entries.answer: 還不太平衡，我常常加班。
entries.answerEnglish: Not very balanced. I often work overtime.

entries.example: 這間咖啡店又明亮又安靜。
entries.exampleEnglish: This café is bright and quiet.
entries.question: 你喜歡明亮的房間嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like bright rooms?
entries.answer: 喜歡，明亮的房間讓我心情好。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, bright rooms put me in a good mood.

entries.example: 這家電影院的銀幕很大。
entries.exampleEnglish: This movie theater has a huge screen.
entries.question: 你喜歡在大銀幕看電影嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like watching movies on the big screen?
entries.answer: 喜歡，大銀幕看起來比較過癮。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, it's more exciting on the big screen.

entries.exampleEnglish: The pancakes here are really fluffy.
entries.question: 你喜歡鬆軟的麵包嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like soft, fluffy bread?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我最愛鬆軟的吐司。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I love soft, fluffy toast.

entries.example: 這裡有危險，請不要進去。
entries.exampleEnglish: It's dangerous here. Please don't go in.
entries.question: 你敢晚上一個人去爬山嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you dare go hiking alone at night?
entries.answer: 不敢，我怕有危險。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I'm afraid it'd be dangerous.

entries.exampleEnglish: I hardly drink at all.
entries.question: 你常喝含糖飲料嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often drink sugary drinks?
entries.answer: 不常，我幾乎都喝無糖的。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I almost always drink sugar-free ones.

entries.exampleEnglish: I'm flying to Japan.
entries.question: 你喜歡坐飛機嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like flying?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我很喜歡坐飛機。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I love flying.

entries.example: 我半夜聽到隔壁小孩的哭聲。
entries.exampleEnglish: In the middle of the night I heard the neighbor's child crying.
entries.question: 你住的地方晚上會聽到哭聲嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you hear crying at night where you live?
entries.answer: 有時候，樓上寶寶的哭聲很大。
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes. The baby upstairs cries loudly.

entries.example: 跨年夜，信義區擠滿了人群。
entries.exampleEnglish: On New Year's Eve, Xinyi District was packed with crowds.
entries.question: 你喜歡待在人群中嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like being in crowds?
entries.answer: 不喜歡，在人群中我會覺得很累。
entries.answerEnglish: No, being in a crowd tires me out.

entries.exampleEnglish: My parents are against me riding a scooter.
entries.question: 你家人反對你來台灣嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Was your family against you coming to Taiwan?
entries.answer: 一開始反對，後來就支持了。
entries.answerEnglish: At first they were against it, but later they supported me.

entries.exampleEnglish: You can pay with your phone here.
entries.question: 你買東西常用什麼方式付款？
entries.questionEnglish: How do you usually pay when you shop?
entries.answer: 我常用悠遊卡付款。
entries.answerEnglish: I usually pay with my EasyCard.

entries.example: 這片草地很寬廣，適合野餐。
entries.exampleEnglish: This lawn is wide and open, great for a picnic.
entries.question: 你喜歡寬廣的地方還是熱鬧的地方？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer wide open spaces or lively places?
entries.answer: 我喜歡寬廣的地方，像海邊。
entries.answerEnglish: I like wide open places, like the beach.

entries.exampleEnglish: I'm going to lunch with my coworkers.
entries.question: 你常跟同事一起吃飯嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often eat with your coworkers?
entries.answer: 常常，我中午都跟同事吃飯。
entries.answerEnglish: Often. I have lunch with my coworkers every day.

entries.exampleEnglish: It's very quiet in the library.
entries.question: 你家附近安靜嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is it quiet around your home?
entries.answer: 不太安靜，晚上很吵。
entries.answerEnglish: Not very quiet. It's noisy at night.

entries.exampleEnglish: Please send me the file.
entries.question: 你電腦裡的檔案整理好了嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are the files on your computer organized?
entries.answer: 沒有，我的檔案很亂。
entries.answerEnglish: No, my files are a mess.

entries.exampleEnglish: In summer I keep the fan on all day.
entries.question: 你家用冷氣還是電風扇？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use air-conditioning or a fan at home?
entries.answer: 我比較常用電風扇，比較省錢。
entries.answerEnglish: I use the fan more; it saves money.

entries.example: 婚禮來了三百多位賓客。
entries.exampleEnglish: Over three hundred guests came to the wedding.
entries.question: 你的婚禮想邀請多少賓客？
entries.questionEnglish: How many guests would you invite to your wedding?
entries.answer: 我想邀請大概五十位賓客就好。
entries.answerEnglish: About fifty guests would be enough.

entries.example: 一台卡車堵住了巷子口。
entries.exampleEnglish: A truck blocked the entrance to the alley.
entries.question: 你家的水管有被堵住過嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have your home's pipes ever been blocked?
entries.answer: 有，頭髮把浴室的水管堵住了。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, hair clogged the bathroom drain.

entries.exampleEnglish: I had two eggs for breakfast.
entries.question: 你早餐喜歡吃蛋嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like eggs for breakfast?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常吃蛋餅。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often have a Taiwanese egg crepe.

entries.example: 在山上可以看到野生的猴子。
entries.exampleEnglish: You can see wild monkeys in the mountains.
entries.question: 你在台灣看過野生動物嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen wild animals in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 看過，我在柴山看過野生猴子。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I saw wild monkeys on Chaishan.

entries.exampleEnglish: You look very young!
entries.question: 你覺得自己還年輕嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you're still young?
entries.answer: 當然，我還很年輕！
entries.answerEnglish: Of course, I'm still young!

entries.example: 這個區域的房租比較便宜。
entries.exampleEnglish: Rent is cheaper in this area.
entries.question: 你住的區域交通方便嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is transportation convenient where you live?
entries.answer: 很方便，我住的區域有捷運站。
entries.answerEnglish: Very convenient. There's an MRT station in my area.

entries.exampleEnglish: He hurt his foot.
entries.question: 你運動時受過傷嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been injured while exercising?
entries.answer: 受過，我打球時手受過傷。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I hurt my hand playing ball.

entries.example: 夜市很多攤位只收現金。
entries.exampleEnglish: Many night market stalls only take cash.
entries.question: 你身上常帶現金嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you usually carry cash?
entries.answer: 常帶，去夜市要用現金。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I need cash for the night market.

entries.exampleEnglish: The itinerary for this trip is packed.
entries.question: 你下次旅行的行程排好了嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you planned the itinerary for your next trip?
entries.answer: 還沒，行程還在想。
entries.answerEnglish: Not yet, I'm still working on the itinerary.

entries.example: 週末我們去博物館看展覽。
entries.exampleEnglish: At the weekend we went to the museum to see an exhibition.
entries.question: 你喜歡去博物館嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like going to museums?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常去台北的博物館。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often go to museums in Taipei.

entries.example: 這個消息很快就傳開了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The news spread quickly.
entries.question: 你公司裡的八卦傳得快嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does gossip spread fast at your company?
entries.answer: 很快，八卦一下子就傳開了。
entries.answerEnglish: Very fast. Gossip spreads in no time.

entries.example: 這部電影在講一件謀殺案。
entries.exampleEnglish: This movie is about a murder case.
entries.question: 你喜歡看謀殺案的推理劇嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like murder mystery dramas?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我很愛看謀殺案的推理劇。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I love murder mysteries.

entries.exampleEnglish: He promised to pay back the money tomorrow.
entries.question: 你最近對自己做了什麼承諾？
entries.questionEnglish: What promise have you made to yourself recently?
entries.answer: 我承諾自己每天學中文。
entries.answerEnglish: I promised myself I'd study Chinese every day.

entries.exampleEnglish: He made a lot of money this month.
entries.question: 你覺得在台灣容易賺錢嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think it's easy to make money in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 不太容易，賺錢很辛苦。
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. Earning money is hard work.

entries.exampleEnglish: The typhoon destroyed a lot of farmland.
entries.question: 你看過被颱風毀壞的地方嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen a place destroyed by a typhoon?
entries.answer: 看過，有一座橋被颱風毀壞了。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I saw a bridge that was destroyed by a typhoon.

entries.example: 這個營地晚上可以看到星星。
entries.exampleEnglish: You can see the stars at night from this campsite.
entries.question: 你去過台灣的營地露營嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you camped at a campsite in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 去過，我去過新竹山上的營地。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've been to a campsite in the Hsinchu mountains.

entries.example: 我們公司的主管大多是女性。
entries.exampleEnglish: Most of the managers at our company are women.
entries.question: 你的公司女性多還是男性多？
entries.questionEnglish: Are there more women or men at your company?
entries.answer: 女性比較多，大概有七成。
entries.answerEnglish: More women, about seventy percent.

entries.example: 我在地圖上標記了想去的餐廳。
entries.exampleEnglish: I marked the restaurants I want to try on the map.
entries.question: 你會在書上做標記嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you make marks in your books?
entries.answer: 會，我會用螢光筆做標記。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I mark them with a highlighter.

entries.exampleEnglish: I really trust my doctor.
entries.question: 你最信任誰？
entries.questionEnglish: Who do you trust the most?
entries.answer: 我最信任我的家人。
entries.answerEnglish: I trust my family the most.

entries.example: 我在捷運上看見我的老師。
entries.exampleEnglish: I saw my teacher on the MRT.
entries.question: 你今天在路上看見了什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What did you see on the street today?
entries.answer: 我看見一隻很可愛的狗。
entries.answerEnglish: I saw a very cute dog.

entries.example: 出門前請確認一下天氣。
entries.exampleEnglish: Check the weather before you go out.
entries.question: 你出門前會確認什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you check before you leave home?
entries.answer: 我會確認有沒有帶鑰匙。
entries.answerEnglish: I check that I have my keys.

entries.exampleEnglish: My grandpa used to be a farmer.
entries.question: 你想當農夫過生活嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to live as a farmer?
entries.answer: 不想，當農夫太辛苦了。
entries.answerEnglish: No, being a farmer is too hard.

entries.exampleEnglish: This trip was unforgettable for me.
entries.question: 你最難忘的旅程是哪一次？
entries.questionEnglish: What's your most unforgettable trip?
entries.answer: 最難忘的旅程是騎機車環島。
entries.answerEnglish: My most unforgettable trip was riding a scooter around Taiwan.

entries.exampleEnglish: I prefer domestic travel.
entries.question: 你在台灣常去國內旅遊嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often travel around Taiwan?
entries.answer: 常去，國內旅遊很方便。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, traveling within the country is easy.

entries.exampleEnglish: This problem is complicated.
entries.question: 你覺得中文的語法複雜嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Chinese grammar is complicated?
entries.answer: 不太複雜，但是聲調很難。
entries.answerEnglish: Not very complicated, but the tones are hard.

entries.exampleEnglish: The waves at sea are big today.
entries.question: 你喜歡在有波浪的海邊玩嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like playing at the beach when there are waves?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我喜歡在波浪裡游泳。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I like swimming in the waves.

entries.example: 這是一家很知名的牛肉麵店。
entries.exampleEnglish: This is a very well-known beef noodle shop.
entries.question: 你知道台灣有哪些知名的小吃？
entries.questionEnglish: Which famous Taiwanese snacks do you know?
entries.answer: 很知名的有小籠包和牛肉麵。
entries.answerEnglish: Well-known ones include xiaolongbao and beef noodles.

entries.example: 我的機車引擎有奇怪的聲音。
entries.exampleEnglish: My scooter's engine is making a strange noise.
entries.question: 你會自己檢查機車的引擎嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you check your scooter's engine yourself?
entries.answer: 不會，引擎有問題我都去機車行。
entries.answerEnglish: No, if the engine has a problem I go to a scooter shop.

entries.example: 一天學會中文是不可能的。
entries.exampleEnglish: It's impossible to learn Chinese in one day.
entries.question: 你覺得一年學好中文可能嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you can master Chinese in a year?
entries.answer: 不可能，至少要三年吧。
entries.answerEnglish: Impossible. It takes at least three years.

entries.exampleEnglish: These trousers are just the right length.
entries.question: 你喜歡什麼長度的頭髮？
entries.questionEnglish: What length of hair do you like?
entries.answer: 我喜歡到肩膀的長度。
entries.answerEnglish: I like it shoulder length.

entries.exampleEnglish: I go running in the park in the morning.
entries.question: 你家附近有公園嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a park near your home?
entries.answer: 有，我家旁邊有公園。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a park next to my home.

entries.exampleEnglish: I often play soccer at the weekend.
entries.question: 你喜歡看足球比賽嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like watching soccer games?
entries.answer: 很喜歡，我常看足球比賽。
entries.answerEnglish: Very much. I often watch soccer.

entries.example: 我們的球隊最後獲勝了。
entries.exampleEnglish: Our team won in the end.
entries.question: 你跟朋友玩遊戲常獲勝嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often win when you play games with friends?
entries.answer: 不常，我很少獲勝。
entries.answerEnglish: Not often. I rarely win.

entries.exampleEnglish: This tastes strange.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣什麼食物很奇怪？
entries.questionEnglish: What Taiwanese food do you find strange?
entries.answer: 我覺得皮蛋很奇怪。
entries.answerEnglish: I think century eggs are weird.

entries.exampleEnglish: I'll send you the link to the website.
entries.question: 你常傳影片連結給朋友嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often send video links to friends?
entries.answer: 常常，我每天都傳連結給朋友。
entries.answerEnglish: All the time. I send my friends links every day.

entries.example: 他在九份向女朋友求婚。
entries.exampleEnglish: He proposed to his girlfriend in Jiufen.
entries.question: 你覺得在哪裡求婚最浪漫？
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you think is the most romantic place to propose?
entries.answer: 我覺得在海邊求婚最浪漫。
entries.answerEnglish: I think proposing at the beach is most romantic.

entries.example: 我的朋友大多住在台北。
entries.exampleEnglish: Most of my friends live in Taipei.
entries.question: 你週末大多做什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you mostly do at the weekend?
entries.answer: 我週末大多在家休息。
entries.answerEnglish: At the weekend I mostly rest at home.

entries.exampleEnglish: I suspect he isn't telling the truth.
entries.question: 你會懷疑網路上的新聞嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you doubt the news you read online?
entries.answer: 會，我常懷疑新聞是假的。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often suspect the news is fake.

entries.example: 我把他的電話號碼抄下來了。
entries.exampleEnglish: I copied down his phone number.
entries.question: 你上課會把生詞抄下來嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you copy down new words in class?
entries.answer: 會，我會把生詞抄在本子上。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I copy new words into my notebook.

entries.example: 可以請你再重複一次嗎？
entries.exampleEnglish: Could you repeat that, please?
entries.question: 你聽不懂時會請別人重複嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When you don't understand, do you ask people to repeat?
entries.answer: 會，我會請他們重複一次。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I ask them to say it again.

entries.example: 我們去山上採集植物做研究。
entries.exampleEnglish: We went to the mountains to collect plants for research.
entries.question: 你小時候採集過昆蟲嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did you collect insects as a child?
entries.answer: 有，我以前常在公園採集昆蟲。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I used to collect insects in the park.

entries.exampleEnglish: The puppy jumped onto the sofa.
entries.question: 你喜歡跳舞嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like dancing?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常跟朋友去跳舞。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often go dancing with friends.

entries.example: 這條河是兩個國家的邊界。
entries.exampleEnglish: This river is the border between two countries.
entries.question: 你有開車越過國家邊界的經驗嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever driven across a national border?
entries.answer: 有，我開車從法國越過邊界到德國。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I drove across the border from France to Germany.

entries.example: 這張海報的文字太小了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The text on this poster is too small.
entries.question: 你覺得中文的文字漂亮嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Chinese writing is beautiful?
entries.answer: 很漂亮，繁體的文字特別美。
entries.answerEnglish: Very. Traditional characters are especially beautiful.

entries.example: 這裡的居民大多是老人。
entries.exampleEnglish: Most of the residents here are elderly.
entries.question: 你住的地方居民友善嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are the residents where you live friendly?
entries.answer: 很友善，附近的居民常跟我聊天。
entries.answerEnglish: Very friendly. The neighbors often chat with me.

entries.exampleEnglish: I'm going to the convenience store to pick up a package.
entries.question: 你常在便利商店取包裹嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often pick up packages at convenience stores?
entries.answer: 常常，我的包裹都寄到便利商店。
entries.answerEnglish: Often. All my packages get sent to the convenience store.

entries.exampleEnglish: I'd like an iced black tea.
entries.question: 你喝飲料喜歡加冰嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like ice in your drinks?
entries.answer: 喜歡，但是我都點少冰。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, but I always order less ice.

entries.example: 他是美國職棒大聯盟的球員。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's a Major League Baseball player.
entries.question: 你喜歡看大聯盟的比賽嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like watching Major League games?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常看大聯盟的棒球。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often watch Major League Baseball.

entries.example: 我們要尊重不同的文化。
entries.exampleEnglish: We should respect different cultures.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣人尊重外國人嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Taiwanese people respect foreigners?
entries.answer: 我覺得大部分台灣人都很尊重外國人。
entries.answerEnglish: I think most Taiwanese people respect foreigners a lot.

entries.exampleEnglish: It's dangerous to swim here.
entries.question: 你覺得騎機車危險嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think riding a scooter is dangerous?
entries.answer: 很危險，所以我都搭捷運。
entries.answerEnglish: Very dangerous, so I always take the MRT.

entries.exampleEnglish: Could I borrow the tape for a moment?
entries.question: 你家的膠帶放在哪裡？
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you keep the tape at home?
entries.answer: 膠帶放在書桌的抽屜裡。
entries.answerEnglish: The tape is in my desk drawer.

entries.exampleEnglish: It's raining outside.
entries.question: 你喜歡下雨天嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like rainy days?
entries.answer: 不喜歡，下雨很麻煩。
entries.answerEnglish: No, rain is a nuisance.

entries.exampleEnglish: She's fluent in three languages.
entries.question: 你精通幾種語言？
entries.questionEnglish: How many languages are you fluent in?
entries.answer: 我精通英文和西班牙文。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm fluent in English and Spanish.

entries.exampleEnglish: It's getting hotter and hotter.
entries.question: 你的中文越來越好了嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is your Chinese getting better and better?
entries.answer: 對，我的中文越來越好了。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my Chinese is getting better and better.

entries.example: 我們買了一打啤酒去海邊。
entries.exampleEnglish: We bought a dozen beers and went to the beach.
entries.question: 你一次會買一打啤酒嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you buy a dozen beers at once?
entries.answer: 不會，一打太多了。
entries.answerEnglish: No, a dozen is too many.

entries.example: 我的居留證下個月到期。
entries.exampleEnglish: My residence permit expires next month.
entries.question: 你的居留證什麼時候到期？
entries.questionEnglish: When does your residence permit expire?
entries.answer: 我的居留證明年三月到期。
entries.answerEnglish: My residence permit expires next March.

entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of tapioca pearls at the bottom of the cup.
entries.question: 你喝珍奶會吃完底部的珍珠嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When you drink bubble tea, do you finish the pearls at the bottom?
entries.answer: 會，底部的珍珠我一定吃完。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always finish the pearls at the bottom.

entries.exampleEnglish: She's wearing a white dress.
entries.question: 你覺得夏天穿洋裝舒服嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think dresses are comfortable in summer?
entries.answer: 很舒服，夏天我常穿洋裝。
entries.answerEnglish: Very. I often wear dresses in summer.

entries.example: 法官明天會宣判這個案子。
entries.exampleEnglish: The judge will deliver the verdict on this case tomorrow.
entries.question: 你會看法院宣判的新聞嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you follow news about court verdicts?
entries.answer: 有時候會，大案子宣判我會看。
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes. I watch when big cases are decided.

entries.exampleEnglish: You should wear a suit on formal occasions.
entries.question: 你在什麼場合會穿正式的衣服？
entries.questionEnglish: On what occasions do you dress formally?
entries.answer: 在婚禮這種場合我會穿正式一點。
entries.answerEnglish: On occasions like weddings I dress more formally.

entries.example: 他對東方文化很有興趣。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's very interested in Eastern culture.
entries.question: 你喜歡東方的哪些文化？
entries.questionEnglish: What parts of Eastern culture do you like?
entries.answer: 我喜歡東方的茶文化。
entries.answerEnglish: I like Eastern tea culture.

entries.example: 我喝熱湯時燙傷了舌頭。
entries.exampleEnglish: I burned my tongue on hot soup.
entries.question: 你煮飯時燙傷過嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you burned yourself cooking?
entries.answer: 燙傷過，手被熱油噴到。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, hot oil splashed on my hand.

entries.exampleEnglish: I like drinking tea.
entries.question: 你喜歡喝茶還是咖啡？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer tea or coffee?
entries.answer: 我喜歡喝茶，不喝咖啡。
entries.answerEnglish: I like tea; I don't drink coffee.

entries.exampleEnglish: I prefer hot drinks.
entries.question: 你比較喜歡夏天還是冬天？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer summer or winter?
entries.answer: 我比較喜歡冬天。
entries.answerEnglish: I prefer winter.

entries.exampleEnglish: This report has lots of errors.
entries.question: 你說中文時常犯什麼錯誤？
entries.questionEnglish: What mistakes do you often make when speaking Chinese?
entries.answer: 我常犯聲調的錯誤。
entries.answerEnglish: I often make tone mistakes.

entries.exampleEnglish: She invited me to dinner at her place.
entries.question: 你最近有邀請朋友來家裡嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you invited friends over recently?
entries.answer: 有，上週我邀請同事來吃飯。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, last week I invited coworkers over for dinner.

entries.exampleEnglish: I'm going to Japan in April.
entries.question: 四月台灣的天氣怎麼樣？
entries.questionEnglish: What's the weather like in Taiwan in April?
entries.answer: 四月不冷也不熱。
entries.answerEnglish: April is neither cold nor hot.

entries.exampleEnglish: We rode our bikes across the bridge.
entries.question: 你家附近有橋嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a bridge near your home?
entries.answer: 有，我家旁邊有一座橋。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a bridge next to my home.

entries.exampleEnglish: I'm happy to help.
entries.question: 朋友搬家，你樂意去幫忙嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: If a friend is moving house, are you happy to help?
entries.answer: 當然，我很樂意幫忙。
entries.answerEnglish: Of course, I'm glad to help.

entries.exampleEnglish: I drink coffee every day.
entries.question: 你每天幾點起床？
entries.questionEnglish: What time do you get up every day?
entries.answer: 我每天七點起床。
entries.answerEnglish: I get up at seven every day.

entries.exampleEnglish: Your Chinese is great!
entries.question: 你覺得台灣什麼很棒？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think is great about Taiwan?
entries.answer: 我覺得台灣的便利商店很棒。
entries.answerEnglish: I think Taiwan's convenience stores are great.

entries.example: 我上網搜尋附近的餐廳。
entries.exampleEnglish: I searched online for nearby restaurants.
entries.question: 你最常上網搜尋什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you search for online most?
entries.answer: 我最常搜尋好吃的餐廳。
entries.answerEnglish: I search for good restaurants most.

entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwan is hot in June.
entries.question: 你六月要做什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What are you doing in June?
entries.answer: 六月我要回國。
entries.answerEnglish: In June I'm going home.

entries.example: 大樓的警衛幫我收包裹。
entries.exampleEnglish: The building's security guard takes in my packages.
entries.question: 你住的大樓有警衛嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your building have a security guard?
entries.answer: 有，我們大樓的警衛很親切。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, our building's guard is very friendly.

entries.example: 他花了五年才還清債務。
entries.exampleEnglish: It took him five years to pay off his debts.
entries.question: 你覺得年輕人有債務很正常嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think it's normal for young people to have debt?
entries.answer: 很正常，很多人都有學貸這種債務。
entries.answerEnglish: Very normal. Lots of people have debt like student loans.

entries.exampleEnglish: He longs to have a home of his own.
entries.question: 你最渴望去哪個國家旅行？
entries.questionEnglish: Which country do you most long to visit?
entries.answer: 我最渴望去冰島旅行。
entries.answerEnglish: I most long to travel to Iceland.

entries.example: 我朋友在出版社當編輯。
entries.exampleEnglish: My friend works as an editor at a publishing house.
entries.question: 你想當雜誌的編輯嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to be a magazine editor?
entries.answer: 不想，編輯的工作太忙了。
entries.answerEnglish: No, editors are too busy.

entries.exampleEnglish: Welcome to Taiwan!
entries.question: 你歡迎朋友來你家玩嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you welcome friends to come over?
entries.answer: 當然，很歡迎他們來玩。
entries.answerEnglish: Of course, they're very welcome.

entries.example: 我們跟銀行貸款買房子。
entries.exampleEnglish: We took out a bank loan to buy a house.
entries.question: 你覺得貸款買房子好嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think it's a good idea to take out a loan to buy a home?
entries.answer: 不太好，貸款的壓力太大了。
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. The pressure of a loan is too much.

entries.example: 我對這次面試很有信心。
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm confident about this interview.
entries.question: 你對說中文有信心嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you confident speaking Chinese?
entries.answer: 越來越有信心了。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm getting more and more confident.

entries.exampleEnglish: Let's have lunch together!
entries.question: 你午餐常吃什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you usually have for lunch?
entries.answer: 我午餐常吃便當。
entries.answerEnglish: I usually have a lunch box for lunch.

entries.example: 按摩可以緩解肩膀的痠痛。
entries.exampleEnglish: A massage can relieve sore shoulders.
entries.question: 你都怎麼緩解工作壓力？
entries.questionEnglish: How do you relieve work stress?
entries.answer: 我都去運動來緩解壓力。
entries.answerEnglish: I exercise to relieve stress.

entries.exampleEnglish: The clothes aren't dry yet.
entries.question: 冬天你的皮膚會很乾嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your skin get dry in winter?
entries.answer: 會，冬天我的皮膚很乾。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my skin gets very dry in winter.

entries.exampleEnglish: The weather is nice today.
entries.question: 你喜歡台灣的天氣嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like the weather in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 不喜歡，天氣太熱了。
entries.answerEnglish: No, the weather is too hot.

entries.exampleEnglish: Go straight ahead and you'll be there.
entries.question: 從你家到捷運站要怎麼走？
entries.questionEnglish: How do you get from your home to the MRT station?
entries.answer: 出門以後直走五分鐘就到了。
entries.answerEnglish: After leaving home, go straight for five minutes and you're there.

entries.exampleEnglish: I'm going to clean out the fridge at the weekend.
entries.question: 你多久清理一次房間？
entries.questionEnglish: How often do you clean your room?
entries.answer: 我每個禮拜清理一次房間。
entries.answerEnglish: I clean my room once a week.

entries.exampleEnglish: This house is quite big.
entries.question: 你覺得台北的房租貴嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think rent in Taipei is expensive?
entries.answer: 相當貴，我一半的薪水都付房租。
entries.answerEnglish: Quite expensive. Half my salary goes on rent.

entries.example: 請把電視的音量關小一點。
entries.exampleEnglish: Please turn the TV volume down a bit.
entries.question: 你聽音樂時音量開很大嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you turn the volume up when you listen to music?
entries.answer: 不會，我的音量都開得很小。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I keep the volume low.

entries.exampleEnglish: This piece of clothing is too expensive.
entries.question: 你覺得台北的東西貴嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think things in Taipei are expensive?
entries.answer: 有的很貴，但小吃不貴。
entries.answerEnglish: Some things are expensive, but street food isn't.

entries.example: 他在地圖上畫了一個圓圈。
entries.exampleEnglish: He drew a circle on the map.
entries.question: 你會在月曆上畫圓圈標重要的日子嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you circle important dates on your calendar?
entries.answer: 會，重要的日子我會畫圓圈。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I circle important days.

entries.example: 你可以推薦一家好吃的餐廳嗎？
entries.exampleEnglish: Can you recommend a good restaurant?
entries.question: 你會推薦朋友來台灣玩嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you recommend Taiwan to your friends?
entries.answer: 會，我很推薦大家來台灣。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I really recommend everyone come to Taiwan.

entries.exampleEnglish: His manners are very polite.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣人的舉止有禮貌嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Taiwanese people have polite manners?
entries.answer: 很有禮貌，大家的舉止都很客氣。
entries.answerEnglish: Very polite. Everyone behaves courteously.

entries.example: 政府補助我們買電動機車。
entries.exampleEnglish: The government subsidized our purchase of an electric scooter.
entries.question: 你的公司有補助學中文嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your company subsidize Chinese lessons?
entries.answer: 有，公司補助一半的學費。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the company covers half the tuition.

entries.exampleEnglish: Please remind me to bring an umbrella tomorrow.
entries.question: 你都用什麼提醒自己做事？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you use to remind yourself of things?
entries.answer: 我都用手機提醒自己。
entries.answerEnglish: I use my phone to remind myself.

entries.exampleEnglish: Things at the night market are cheap.
entries.question: 你覺得在哪裡買衣服便宜？
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you think it's cheap to buy clothes?
entries.answer: 網路上的衣服比較便宜。
entries.answerEnglish: Clothes online are cheaper.

entries.exampleEnglish: He wore a suit to his interview today.
entries.question: 你上班要穿西裝嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have to wear a suit to work?
entries.answer: 不用，我上班不穿西裝。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I don't wear a suit to work.

entries.exampleEnglish: Please put the bottle in the recycling bin.
entries.question: 你喝完水會回收瓶子嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you recycle bottles after you finish drinking?
entries.answer: 會，我都把瓶子拿去回收。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always recycle the bottles.

entries.example: 我爸媽的想法比較保守。
entries.exampleEnglish: My parents are fairly conservative in their thinking.
entries.question: 你覺得自己是保守的人嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you're a conservative person?
entries.answer: 不是，我的想法不太保守。
entries.answerEnglish: No, my views aren't very conservative.

entries.example: 台灣的美食吸引了很多遊客。
entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwan's food attracts a lot of tourists.
entries.question: 台灣的什麼最吸引你？
entries.questionEnglish: What about Taiwan attracts you most?
entries.answer: 台灣的美食最吸引我。
entries.answerEnglish: Taiwan's food attracts me most.

entries.exampleEnglish: Three plus five equals eight.
entries.question: 你的咖啡要加糖嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you take sugar in your coffee?
entries.answer: 不用，我不加糖。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I don't take sugar.

entries.example: 這個月的電費帳單很貴。
entries.exampleEnglish: This month's electricity bill is very high.
entries.question: 你每個月要付哪些帳單？
entries.questionEnglish: What bills do you have to pay each month?
entries.answer: 我要付手機、水費和電費的帳單。
entries.answerEnglish: I pay my phone, water and electricity bills.

entries.exampleEnglish: Your pronunciation is very accurate.
entries.question: 你覺得你的聲調正確嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think your tones are correct?
entries.answer: 不太正確，我常說錯。
entries.answerEnglish: Not very. I often get them wrong.

entries.example: 這兩個房間的大小相等。
entries.exampleEnglish: These two rooms are equal in size.
entries.question: 你覺得男女的薪水相等嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think men's and women's pay is equal?
entries.answer: 不一定相等，男生常拿比較多。
entries.answerEnglish: Not always equal. Men often get more.

entries.exampleEnglish: I buy train tickets online.
entries.question: 你回家的車票買了嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you bought your ticket home?
entries.answer: 買了，我昨天買了車票。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I bought my ticket yesterday.

entries.exampleEnglish: Aircraft fuel is very expensive.
entries.question: 你覺得以後的車會用什麼燃料？
entries.questionEnglish: What fuel do you think cars will use in the future?
entries.answer: 我覺得以後的車會用電，不用燃料了。
entries.answerEnglish: I think cars will run on electricity and won't need fuel.

entries.example: 書架上的書照顏色排列。
entries.exampleEnglish: The books on the shelf are arranged by color.
entries.question: 你的衣服是怎麼排列的？
entries.questionEnglish: How are your clothes arranged?
entries.answer: 我的衣服是照顏色排列的。
entries.answerEnglish: My clothes are arranged by color.

entries.exampleEnglish: I'm cooking noodles at home tonight.
entries.question: 你常自己煮飯嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often cook for yourself?
entries.answer: 不常，我很少自己煮飯。
entries.answerEnglish: Not often. I rarely cook.

entries.exampleEnglish: Please speak a bit more slowly.
entries.question: 你說中文說得很慢嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you speak Chinese slowly?
entries.answer: 對，我說得很慢。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I speak slowly.

entries.example: 我們的導遊很會說故事。
entries.exampleEnglish: Our tour guide is great at telling stories.
entries.question: 你想在台灣當導遊嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to be a tour guide in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 想，我想當英文導遊。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd like to be an English-speaking guide.

entries.exampleEnglish: I tied my hair up.
entries.question: 你夏天會把頭髮綁起來嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you tie your hair up in summer?
entries.answer: 會，太熱了，我都綁馬尾。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, it's too hot. I always wear a ponytail.

entries.example: 洗手是防疫的第一道防線。
entries.exampleEnglish: Washing your hands is the first line of defense against disease.
entries.question: 你覺得防疫最重要的防線是什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think is the most important line of defense against disease?
entries.answer: 我覺得勤洗手是最重要的防線。
entries.answerEnglish: I think washing your hands often is the most important line of defense.

entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwan's fruit is delicious.
entries.question: 你最喜歡吃什麼水果？
entries.questionEnglish: What's your favorite fruit?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡的水果是芒果。
entries.answerEnglish: My favorite fruit is mango.

entries.exampleEnglish: We painted the walls at home at the weekend.
entries.question: 你自己刷過油漆嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever done your own painting?
entries.answer: 刷過，我自己幫房間刷油漆。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I painted my room myself.

entries.exampleEnglish: My desk is very messy.
entries.question: 你的書桌上有什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What's on your desk?
entries.answer: 我的書桌上有電腦和書。
entries.answerEnglish: There's a computer and books on my desk.

entries.example: 適當的運動對身體很好。
entries.exampleEnglish: The right amount of exercise is good for you.
entries.question: 你覺得一天喝幾杯咖啡比較適當？
entries.questionEnglish: How many cups of coffee a day do you think is about right?
entries.answer: 我覺得一天兩杯比較適當。
entries.answerEnglish: I think two cups a day is about right.

entries.exampleEnglish: We cut the cake into four pieces.
entries.question: 你跟朋友吃飯會分開付錢嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When you eat with friends, do you split the bill?
entries.answer: 會，我們都分開付。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we always pay separately.

entries.example: 這個小鎮四周被山圍繞。
entries.exampleEnglish: This small town is surrounded by mountains.
entries.question: 你喜歡被大自然圍繞的感覺嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like the feeling of being surrounded by nature?
entries.answer: 很喜歡，被大自然圍繞讓我很放鬆。
entries.answerEnglish: Very much. Being surrounded by nature relaxes me.

entries.example: 整體來說，這次旅行很不錯。
entries.exampleEnglish: Overall, this trip was great.
entries.question: 整體來說，你喜歡台灣的生活嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: On the whole, do you like life in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 整體來說，我很喜歡。
entries.answerEnglish: On the whole, I like it a lot.

entries.exampleEnglish: I run three miles every morning.
entries.question: 你知道一英里是幾公里嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know how many kilometers are in a mile?
entries.answer: 一英里大概是一點六公里。
entries.answerEnglish: A mile is about 1.6 kilometers.

entries.example: 這附近都是住宅，晚上很安靜。
entries.exampleEnglish: It's all residential around here, so it's quiet at night.
entries.question: 你住在住宅區還是商業區？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you live in a residential or a commercial area?
entries.answer: 我住在住宅區，晚上很安靜。
entries.answerEnglish: I live in a residential area. It's quiet at night.

entries.exampleEnglish: Taipei is nice and cool in autumn.
entries.question: 你喜歡涼爽的天氣嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like cool weather?
entries.answer: 很喜歡，涼爽的天氣最舒服。
entries.answerEnglish: Very much. Cool weather is the most comfortable.

entries.exampleEnglish: The MRT station entrance is across the street.
entries.question: 你家大樓的入口在哪裡？
entries.questionEnglish: Where's the entrance to your building?
entries.answer: 入口在便利商店旁邊。
entries.answerEnglish: The entrance is next to the convenience store.

entries.exampleEnglish: The floor's slippery; be careful not to slip.
entries.question: 你在下雨天滑倒過嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever slipped on a rainy day?
entries.answer: 滑倒過，在捷運站門口。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, at the entrance to an MRT station.

entries.exampleEnglish: My dad works in a factory.
entries.question: 你參觀過台灣的觀光工廠嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you visited one of Taiwan's tourist factories?
entries.answer: 參觀過，我去過一間餅乾工廠。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I visited a cookie factory.

entries.exampleEnglish: Don't waste food.
entries.question: 你覺得滑手機是浪費時間嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think scrolling on your phone is a waste of time?
entries.answer: 有時候是，我常浪費很多時間。
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes. I often waste a lot of time.

entries.example: 修車前，師傅先幫我估價。
entries.exampleEnglish: Before fixing the car, the mechanic gave me a quote.
entries.question: 你修東西前會先請人估價嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you get a quote before having something repaired?
entries.answer: 會，我會先請人估價再決定。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I get a quote first and then decide.

entries.example: 只有少數人知道這家店。
entries.exampleEnglish: Only a few people know about this shop.
entries.question: 你覺得會說台語的外國人是少數嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think foreigners who speak Taiwanese are a minority?
entries.answer: 是少數，大部分只會說中文。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, they're few. Most only speak Mandarin.

entries.exampleEnglish: Abusing animals is illegal.
entries.question: 你覺得虐待動物的人應該被關嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think people who abuse animals should go to jail?
entries.answer: 應該，虐待動物的人一定要受罰。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, people who abuse animals must be punished.

entries.exampleEnglish: I like reading novels before bed.
entries.question: 你最近在看什麼小說？
entries.questionEnglish: What novel are you reading lately?
entries.answer: 我在看一本推理小說。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm reading a mystery novel.

entries.example: 英國國會今天在討論新法律。
entries.exampleEnglish: The British Parliament is debating a new law today.
entries.question: 你會看國會開會的新聞嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you watch news about parliament sessions?
entries.answer: 很少，我不太關心國會的新聞。
entries.answerEnglish: Rarely. I don't pay much attention to parliament news.

entries.example: 下雨天我的膝蓋關節會痛。
entries.exampleEnglish: My knee joints hurt on rainy days.
entries.question: 你運動後關節會痛嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do your joints hurt after exercise?
entries.answer: 會，跑步後我的膝蓋關節會痛。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my knee joints hurt after running.

entries.exampleEnglish: This bird's wing is injured.
entries.question: 如果你有翅膀，你想飛去哪裡？
entries.questionEnglish: If you had wings, where would you fly?
entries.answer: 如果有翅膀，我想飛回家。
entries.answerEnglish: If I had wings, I'd fly home.

entries.example: 老闆在會議上批評了我的報告。
entries.exampleEnglish: My boss criticized my report in the meeting.
entries.question: 被別人批評時，你會怎麼做？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do when someone criticizes you?
entries.answer: 被批評時，我會先冷靜聽完。
entries.answerEnglish: When I'm criticized, I calmly hear them out first.

entries.exampleEnglish: I need some time to think.
entries.question: 你喜歡在哪裡思考事情？
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you like to think things over?
entries.answer: 我喜歡一邊散步一邊思考。
entries.answerEnglish: I like to think while I'm walking.

entries.exampleEnglish: Please reply as soon as you see the message.
entries.question: 老闆傳訊息，你會立即回嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When your boss messages you, do you reply right away?
entries.answer: 會，我通常會立即回覆。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I usually reply immediately.

entries.exampleEnglish: When we went hiking, he led the way in front.
entries.question: 團體旅行時，你喜歡領頭走在前面嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: On group trips, do you like to lead the way?
entries.answer: 不喜歡，我喜歡跟在領頭的人後面。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I like to follow behind the leader.

entries.example: 比賽的優勝者可以免費去日本玩。
entries.exampleEnglish: The winner of the contest gets a free trip to Japan.
entries.question: 你當過比賽的優勝者嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever won a contest?
entries.answer: 當過一次，我是公司桌球比賽的優勝者。
entries.answerEnglish: Once. I won the company table tennis tournament.

entries.exampleEnglish: I can do two things at the same time.
entries.question: 你會一邊工作一邊聽音樂嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you listen to music while you work?
entries.answer: 會，我常同時工作和聽音樂。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often work and listen to music at the same time.

entries.example: 遇到緊急狀況要打一一九。
entries.exampleEnglish: In an emergency, call 119.
entries.question: 遇到緊急狀況，你知道要打幾號嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know what number to call in an emergency?
entries.answer: 知道，緊急狀況要打一一九。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, in an emergency you call 119.

entries.exampleEnglish: I usually get up at seven.
entries.question: 你平常週末做什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you usually do at the weekend?
entries.answer: 我平常週末去爬山。
entries.answerEnglish: I usually go hiking at the weekend.

entries.exampleEnglish: Be careful crossing the street!
entries.question: 你騎車的時候小心嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you careful when you ride?
entries.answer: 很小心，我騎得很慢。
entries.answerEnglish: Very careful. I ride slowly.

entries.example: 飯店房門後面有逃生路線圖。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's an escape route map on the back of the hotel room door.
entries.question: 你知道你家大樓的逃生門在哪裡嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know where the emergency exit in your building is?
entries.answer: 知道，逃生門在電梯旁邊。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the emergency exit is next to the elevator.

entries.example: 這條巷子很狹窄，車子開不進去。
entries.exampleEnglish: This alley is so narrow cars can't get in.
entries.question: 你家附近的巷子狹窄嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are the alleys near your home narrow?
entries.answer: 很狹窄，只能騎機車進去。
entries.answerEnglish: Very narrow. You can only get in on a scooter.

entries.exampleEnglish: The current in this river is very fast.
entries.question: 你敢在水流很急的地方游泳嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you dare swim where the current is strong?
entries.answer: 不敢，水流太急很危險。
entries.answerEnglish: No, a strong current is dangerous.

entries.example: 下個月由小林接替我的工作。
entries.exampleEnglish: Next month Xiao Lin will take over my job.
entries.question: 你休假時，誰接替你的工作？
entries.questionEnglish: Who takes over your work when you're on leave?
entries.answer: 我休假時，同事會接替我的工作。
entries.answerEnglish: When I'm on leave, a coworker takes over my work.

entries.example: 在捷運上吃東西會被處以罰款。
entries.exampleEnglish: Eating on the MRT can get you fined.
entries.question: 你知道在捷運上喝水會被罰嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know you can be fined for drinking water on the MRT?
entries.answer: 知道，在捷運上喝水會被處以罰款。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, drinking water on the MRT can get you fined.

entries.example: 這位政治人物常上電視。
entries.exampleEnglish: This politician is often on TV.
entries.question: 你喜歡你國家的政治人物嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like the politicians in your country?
entries.answer: 不太喜歡，很多政治人物只會說不會做。
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. Many politicians are all talk and no action.

entries.exampleEnglish: She dresses very stylishly.
entries.question: 你覺得台北人穿得時尚嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think people in Taipei dress fashionably?
entries.answer: 很時尚，很多年輕人很會穿。
entries.answerEnglish: Very. Lots of young people dress well.

entries.example: 店裡陳列著很多手工藝品。
entries.exampleEnglish: The shop has lots of handicrafts on display.
entries.question: 你家裡有陳列什麼收藏品嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you display any collections at home?
entries.answer: 有，我的書架上陳列著很多公仔。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have lots of figurines displayed on my bookshelf.
